page.overview:
Who is Bi-Plane?

Bi-Plane was a notorious winged criminal in Denver, known for robbing banks using his flying contraption. Eventually, he discovered that he had contracted cancer and decided to lace himself with plutonium, planning to blow himself up above the city, which would have made the entire area radioactive. Fortunately for the residents, The Immortal arrived on the scene, quickly apprehended Bi-Plane, and threw him into space, killing him instantly. Later, Invincible encounters Bi-Plane's corpse in space during his trip to Mars.

Bi-Plane is a slender, bald man with pale skin. He wears a green jumpsuit that has lighter green sections on the limbs, complemented by a brown harness and boots. His most distinctive feature is the large jet pack he wears, which resembles a combination of a jet turbine and the wings of an airplane.

What little is seen of Bi-Plane shows that he is a maniacal, genocidal, and suicidal. Not only was he willing to kill himself, but an entire city with plutonium explosives that he had lined into his suit. Bi-Plane also appears to be boastful, arrogant, cocky, and absent-minded. He ran on with his monologue and did not even bother to pay attention to the Immortal who wasted no time in neutralizing him.
